hooks.command: PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin${PATH:+:$PATH}"; export PATH; for required in git bash; do if ! command -v "$required" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "BLOCKED: required executable unavailable: $required" >&2; exit 2; fi; done; guard_rel=".claude/hooks/guard-collaborative-git.sh"; git_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; env_root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; if [ -z "$git_root" ] && [ -z "$env_root" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: unable to resolve the Git repository root." >&2; exit 2; fi; guard_path=""; for candidate_root in "$git_root" "$env_root"; do if [ -n "$candidate_root" ] && [ -f "$candidate_root/$guard_rel" ] && [ -r "$candidate_root/$guard_rel" ]; then guard_path="$candidate_root/$guard_rel"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$guard_path" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: required guard unavailable: $guard_rel" >&2; exit 2; fi; exec bash "$guard_path"
